correctness.rationale: The actual D+ piecewise-affine vertex strings generate 2(j+2)+1 self-block branches and 2(j+2) adjacent-block branches, giving the finite multigraph M_K with endpoint escapes excluded. Expanding branches ensure that the survivor’s finite edge shift has entropy log rho; multiple endpoint codings contribute no entropy. Symmetrization produces Jacobi d_j=2j+5 and b_j=2sqrt((j+2)(j+3)), so the continuant P_{j+1}=(z-2j-5)P_j-4(j+1)(j+2)P_{j-1}. Identity 6K-<v,Jv>=sum b_j (v_{j+1}-v_j)^2+sum (6K-V_j)v_j² localizes eigenvectors on K^(1/3) terminal sites. The rigorous limsup via Dirichlet test functions and liminf via energy-tightness, compactness and lower semicontinuity identify -2u+6t u with u(0)=0. Airy zero a1 gives constant (2·6²)^(1/3). Directly verified finite Jacobi/Perron identity K=1..18 and rho(M1)=11; those finite checks do not prove the asymptotic.
